title: Canonical comparison from the etale structure-ring stalk to the affine strict henselization
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let $E_{X,\bar x}$ be the ring-valued geometric stalk denoted $\operatorname{strictLocalRing}(X,\bar x)$ in [def-trf-log-regular-pair], and let $A^{\rm sh}_{X,\bar x}$ be the colimit of the affine pointed-neighbourhood coordinate rings [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Define the canonical comparison $E_{X,\bar x}\xrightarrow{\sim}A^{\rm sh}_{X,\bar x}$ by the geometric-stalk colimit cocone, restriction to affine pointed neighbourhoods, and transport to the chosen small representative diagram. Its direction is from the geometric stalk to the affine colimit, and it identifies the two germs of every regular function on a pointed affine neighbourhood.
